notes.14: The topic for this question was thermal expansion, and almost half the responses were incorrect. Candidates were required to link the increased volume of the heated disc to decreased density, and this proved difficult for many.
notes.18: A large majority of candidates were aware that wavelength, rather than frequency, could be measured from the diagram shown, but some believed the wave to be longitudinal.
notes.22: In this question on refraction a large number of candidates chose option B, being unaware that some light is reflected internally even if the angle of incidence in the glass is less than the critical angle; the syllabus refers to ‘internal and total internal reflection’.
